title: Larkspur Credit Cards Underwriting Guidelines: Application Decisions and Secured Card Graduation
content:
These guidelines cover how an application for one of the Larkspur Credit Cards is decided, and how a Larkspur Secured Visa account moves up to the Larkspur Classic Visa.

## 1. Application decisions

An applicant is approved for the card applied for when they meet its minimum credit score and income, with a limit inside the card's limit range set by underwriting. Otherwise they may be offered the next lower card they qualify for, or declined.

The terms a decision rests on are each card's:

- minimum FICO Score 8 at application;
- minimum stated gross annual income;
- lowest and highest credit limit.

These are named in the card's product terms. The outcome is one of three:

| Applicant against the card applied for | Outcome |
|---|---|
| Meets the card's minimum credit score and minimum income | Approved for that card, with a limit inside its limit range set by underwriting |
| Does not meet them | May be offered the next lower card they qualify for, or declined |

"Next lower" follows the card ladder from the highest card down: Larkspur Travel Rewards Visa Signature, Larkspur Cash Back Visa Signature, Larkspur Balance Transfer Visa Platinum, Larkspur Cash Back Visa, Larkspur Classic Visa, Larkspur Secured Visa.

## 2. The Larkspur Secured Visa

The Larkspur Secured Visa needs no minimum score. Its limit equals the refundable deposit, between the minimum and maximum deposit. A secured account opens once the application is approved and the deposit is funded.

## 3. Graduation review

A secured account is reviewed 7 months after opening; it graduates to the Larkspur Classic Visa only when the account is in active status, has no amount past due and has made every payment on time.

This is checked against the system record of that same secured card account, before the product change. Three conditions must all hold:

| Account status is active | Amount past due is 0.00 | Every payment made on time | Graduation |
|---|---|---|---|
| Yes | Yes | Yes | The conditions for graduation are met |
| No (for example suspended or closed) | either | either | Does not graduate |
| Yes | No | either | Does not graduate |
| Yes | Yes | No | Does not graduate |

On graduation:

- the deposit is returned, and the account record then shows a security deposit of 0.00;
- the card product becomes the Larkspur Classic Visa;
- the limit stays the same;
- the account keeps its history.

## Hypothetical graduation case

The figures and dates here are invented. A Larkspur Secured Visa with a 600.00 deposit, and so a 600.00 limit, reaches its review month. The account is active, nothing is past due, and every payment was made on time.

On graduation it becomes a Larkspur Classic Visa with a 600.00 limit, the 600.00 deposit is returned, and its earlier statements and payments remain part of the account.

Had one payment been made late, the account would not graduate at that review.
